stem_book: A uniform rod of length L and mass M lies on a smooth horizontal table. A particle of mass m moving on the table with speed v strikes the rod perpendicularly at one end and sticks to the rod after the collision. Find the velocity of the centre of mass C of the system constituting “the rod plus the particle”.
key: v C = mv/(M + m), along the particle's original direction
correct_answer: v_C = mv/(M + m), along the particle's initial velocity
reason: print says 'the particle of the previous problem' (the setup is Level-4 Q7, printed after it); setup written into the stem
work: momentum: mv = (M + m)v_C ⇒ v_C = mv/(M + m)
